# Sanitized MPRIS evidence fixtures

These fixtures preserve previously supplied Firefox-native and KDE Plasma
Browser Integration observations. They contain no private home path or account
credential. Their exact raw titles, channel/artist values, URLs, missing fields,
positions, and durations are project-history evidence for proposed Stage 1 and
later duplicate/identity tests.

Their presence does not mean MPRIS behavior is implemented, tested
automatically, or tested manually. Do not normalize or rewrite them to fit an
implementation. Add a new sanitized fixture when later evidence differs.
